The fix is commit `0e06523b` (PR #3792, ticket O3-6100, "Prevent duplicate vitals saves"). It adds `return` in front of the `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(...)` call in the save handler, so the promise reaches the form and "Save and close" stays disabled until the request finishes. The change is on line 225 of `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx`, as it stands at the fix commit. The same commit adds two tests: one double-clicks Save and close while the request is pending and expects one call, and one checks that a failed save can be retried without losing the entered values.

I found the commit through a commit-message search for the ticket, and confirmed the PR link and the diff with `get_provenance` and `get_diff`. I did not check whether later commits moved the line.
